description: WindowGroup content receives only value-type projection data; no reference-typed lifecycle ModelContext or ModelObject is passed directly into the view.
assertions: all data passed into WindowGroup content is value-type (struct/enum)
no ModelObject reference types directly bound in WindowGroup closure
no lifecycle ModelContext injected via .modelContext modifier in WindowGroup
projection types (RunProjection, StageProjection) are Sendable structs
mutations route through service layer, not direct context inside window
